attchmntText: Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Alpa Laboratories Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 14th November 2026. The Board approved the Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended 30th September 2026. The results include a Limited Review Report from the Statutory Auditor. For the quarter ended September 2026, the Standalone revenue from operations was 3,097.56 lacs, with a loss before tax of 187.01 lacs. The Consolidated revenue from operations was also 3,097.56 lacs, showing a loss before tax of 184.54 lacs. The Standalone Basic and Diluted Earnings Per Share was negative 0.89, while the Consolidated EPS was negative 0.85. The meeting commenced at 02:00 PM and concluded at 06:30 PM.
